name: HubSpot
description: Trigger workflows from new HubSpot contacts, companies and deals or deal stage changes, and create, update, search, annotate or associate CRM records from a step.

triggers.label: A contact is created
triggers.description: Fires once for each contact created since the last poll, oldest first.

env.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: The access token of a private app from Settings, Integrations, Private Apps, with the crm.objects.contacts, crm.objects.companies and crm.objects.deals read and write scopes, crm.objects.owners.read and crm.schemas.deals.read.
env.builderHint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer on every call. A wrong or revoked token answers 401; a token missing a scope answers 403 MISSING_SCOPES naming the scope. There is no HubSpot CLI to borrow a CRM login from.

env.name: HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID
env.description: The account number in the app.hubspot.com URL, used to give each item a link to open the record. Blank leaves items without a URL.
env.builderHint: No API answer carries it, so the record URL https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/{portalId}/record/{objectTypeId}/{id} can only be built when it is set.

env.name: HUBSPOT_PROPERTIES
env.description: Comma-separated internal property names every trigger fetches on top of the standard set.
env.builderHint: Appended to the search body’s properties list; HubSpot ignores a name the account lacks.

env.name: HUBSPOT_PIPELINE
env.description: A pipeline id from listDealPipelines; the deal triggers then watch only that pipeline. Blank watches every pipeline.
env.builderHint: Adds { propertyName: "pipeline", operator: "EQ" } to the deal searches; the default pipeline’s id is "default".

env.name: HUBSPOT_DEAL_STAGE
env.description: A stage id such as closedwon or a numeric custom stage id; the stage-changed trigger then fires only for deals reaching it.
env.builderHint: Adds { propertyName: "dealstage", operator: "EQ" } to the stage-changed search only; stage ids come from listDealPipelines.

actions.label: Create a contact
actions.description: Add a contact by email. An email that already exists answers 409 with the existing id in the message.

inputs.label: Email
inputs.description: The contact’s email address, HubSpot’s unique identifier for contacts.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.email; a duplicate answers 409 CONFLICT "Contact already exists. Existing ID: <id>", which the thrown message carries.

inputs.label: First name
inputs.description: First name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.firstname.

inputs.label: Last name
inputs.description: Last name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.lastname.

inputs.label: Phone
inputs.description: Phone number.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.phone, unformatted.

inputs.label: Company
inputs.description: Company name, as a text property on the contact rather than an association.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.company; use associate to link the contact to a company record.

inputs.label: Properties
inputs.description: A JSON object of extra properties to set keyed by internal property name, e.g. {"lifecyclestage":"customer"}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the properties object of the JSON body; values are written as strings because HubSpot stores every property as one, and a name the account lacks answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

outputs.description: Record id, a numeric string
The properties HubSpot returned, every value a string or null
When the record was created, ISO 8601
When the record last changed, ISO 8601
Whether the record is archived

actions.label: Update a contact
actions.description: Set the given properties of a contact and leave the rest as they were.

inputs.label: Contact
inputs.description: The contact’s record id, such as 33451.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of PATCH /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{id}; an unknown id answers 404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.

inputs.label: Properties
inputs.description: A JSON object of properties to set keyed by internal property name, e.g. {"lifecyclestage":"customer"}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the properties object of the JSON body; values are written as strings because HubSpot stores every property as one, and a name the account lacks answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

outputs.description: Record id, a numeric string
The properties HubSpot returned, every value a string or null
When the record was created, ISO 8601
When the record last changed, ISO 8601
Whether the record is archived

actions.label: Create a deal
actions.description: Add a deal at a stage of a pipeline. Every call makes a new deal.

inputs.label: Deal name
inputs.description: The deal’s name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.dealname.

inputs.label: Stage
inputs.description: A stage id from listDealPipelines, such as appointmentscheduled or closedwon in the default pipeline; custom stages are numeric.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.dealstage; a stage outside the chosen pipeline answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

inputs.label: Pipeline
inputs.description: A pipeline id from listDealPipelines. Blank uses the default pipeline.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.pipeline when set; "If a pipeline isn’t specified, the default pipeline will be used".

inputs.label: Amount
inputs.description: The deal amount in the account’s currency.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.amount written out as a decimal string such as 1500.00.

inputs.label: Close date
inputs.description: The expected close date as an ISO 8601 instant, such as 2019-12-07T16:50:06.678Z.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.closedate; HubSpot answers it back in the same form.

inputs.label: Owner
inputs.description: The owner id from listOwners, its id rather than its userId.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as hubspot_owner_id; a userId in its place answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

inputs.label: Properties
inputs.description: A JSON object of extra properties to set keyed by internal property name, e.g. {"lifecyclestage":"customer"}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the properties object of the JSON body; values are written as strings because HubSpot stores every property as one, and a name the account lacks answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

outputs.description: Record id, a numeric string
The properties HubSpot returned, every value a string or null
When the record was created, ISO 8601
When the record last changed, ISO 8601
Whether the record is archived

actions.label: Create a company
actions.description: Add a company by name, with its domain when known. Every call makes a new company.

inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: The company name.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.name.

inputs.label: Domain
inputs.description: The website domain such as hubspot.com, HubSpot’s unique identifier for companies.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.domain; HubSpot does not refuse a duplicate domain, so a repeat makes a second company.

inputs.label: Properties
inputs.description: A JSON object of extra properties to set keyed by internal property name, e.g. {"lifecyclestage":"customer"}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the properties object of the JSON body; values are written as strings because HubSpot stores every property as one, and a name the account lacks answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

outputs.description: Record id, a numeric string
The properties HubSpot returned, every value a string or null
When the record was created, ISO 8601
When the record last changed, ISO 8601
Whether the record is archived

actions.label: Add a note to a record
actions.description: Attach a note to a contact, company or deal, stamped with the current time.

inputs.label: Record type
inputs.description: What the note is attached to: contact, company or deal.
inputs.builderHint: Picks the association type id of the note: 202 to a contact, 190 to a company, 214 to a deal.

inputs.label: Record
inputs.description: The record id to attach the note to.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as associations[0].to.id; an unknown id answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

inputs.label: Note
inputs.description: The note text, up to 65,536 characters.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as properties.hs_note_body; hs_timestamp is filled with the current instant because HubSpot requires it.

inputs.label: Owner
inputs.description: The owner id from listOwners, its id rather than its userId.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as hubspot_owner_id; a userId in its place answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

outputs.description: Record id, a numeric string
The properties HubSpot returned, every value a string or null
When the record was created, ISO 8601
When the record last changed, ISO 8601
Whether the record is archived

actions.label: Associate two records
actions.description: Link two records with the default association for their types, or with a labelled type id.

inputs.label: From type
inputs.description: contact, company, deal or note, or an object type id such as 0-1.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the first path segment of PUT /crm/v4/objects/{from}/{id}/associations/...

inputs.label: From record
inputs.description: The record id to link from.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the second path segment.

inputs.label: To type
inputs.description: contact, company, deal or note, or an object type id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded after /associations/default/ or /associations/ when a type id is given.

inputs.label: To record
inputs.description: The record id to link to.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the last path segment.

inputs.label: Association type id
inputs.description: A labelled type id such as 1 for a contact’s primary company. Blank uses the default association for the two types.
inputs.builderHint: When set the labelled form is used: PUT .../associations/{to}/{toId} with body [{ associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId }]; the defaults are contact→company 279, company→contact 280, contact→deal 4, deal→contact 3, deal→company 341, company→deal 342, contact→note 201, company→note 189, deal→note 213.

outputs.description: The from record’s object type id, such as 0-1
The from record id
The to record’s object type id, such as 0-3
The to record id
The association labels now in place, such as ["Point of contact"]

actions.label: Get a contact
actions.description: Read one contact by record id or by email address.

inputs.label: Contact
inputs.description: The contact’s record id, or an email address to look it up by.
inputs.builderHint: A value with an @ is sent as GET /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{email}?idProperty=email; anything else as the record id. An unknown one answers 404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.

inputs.label: Properties to return
inputs.description: Comma-separated internal property names to return; blank returns the standard set.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the properties list; a name the account lacks is ignored rather than refused.

outputs.description: Record id, a numeric string
The properties HubSpot returned, every value a string or null
When the record was created, ISO 8601
When the record last changed, ISO 8601
Whether the record is archived

actions.label: Search contacts
actions.description: Find contacts by free text or by filter groups, one page at a time.

inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: Text matched against the default searchable properties: name, email, phone and company.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as query, at most 3,000 characters; archived contacts are excluded from search.

inputs.label: Filter groups
inputs.description: A JSON array of { "filters": [{ "propertyName", "operator", "value" }] } groups exactly as the search API takes them; groups are ORed and filters within one ANDed.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as filterGroups, at most 5 groups of 6 filters; a bare filter object is taken as a group of one. Date values are epoch milliseconds as strings.

inputs.label: Properties to return
inputs.description: Comma-separated internal property names to return; blank returns the standard set.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the properties list; a name the account lacks is ignored rather than refused.

inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: Contacts per page, 1 to 200. Defaults to 10.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as limit; the search API is limited to five requests per second and 10,000 results per query.

inputs.label: After
inputs.description: The paging.next.after cursor from an earlier page.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as after; HubSpot wants a numeric string and refuses paging past 10,000 results with 400.

outputs.description: How many contacts match in all
The page of matching records, each { id, properties, createdAt, updatedAt, archived }
Pass back as after to fetch the next page; empty on the last one

actions.label: List deal pipelines
actions.description: The deal pipelines of the account with their stages.

outputs.description: One entry per pipeline: id, label, displayOrder, archived, stages [{ id, label, displayOrder, metadata: { probability } }]

actions.label: List owners
actions.description: The users who can own records, with the id to assign a record by.

inputs.label: Email
inputs.description: Only the owner with this email address.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the email query parameter; the answer is then a list of one or none.

inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: Owners per page. Defaults to 100.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the limit query parameter.

inputs.label: After
inputs.description: The paging.next.after cursor from an earlier page.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the after query parameter; the answer’s paging.next.after names the next page.

inputs.label: Archived
inputs.description: List deactivated users instead of active ones.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the archived query parameter.

outputs.description: One entry per owner: id, email, firstName, lastName, userId, type, archived, createdAt, updatedAt, teams; assign records by id, never userId
Pass back as after to fetch the next page; empty on the last one
